representation_plans.learner_operation: Identify sugar, phosphate, base, and the repeating backbone-to-base organization.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List every labelled atom-group connection in reading order, including sugar-to-base and sugar-to-phosphate links, without naming the requested structure.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Predict whether a change affects polymer continuity, sugar identity, or a projecting base residue.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Describe the changed bond and the components on each side of it without stating the structural consequence.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Pair A with T and G with C while preserving opposite strand orientations.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: State both strand sequences with explicit five-prime and three-prime labels in aligned positions.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Predict separation or pairing from backbone integrity and complementary base matches.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List each candidate strand, its orientation, and each aligned base position without marking the best match.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Trace parental templates, primer placement, five-prime-to-three-prime synthesis, and fragment sealing.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Describe each strand orientation and every labelled enzyme action in fork order without predicting the missing product.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Predict how origin number and enzyme disruption affect copied regions and completion.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List origin positions, fork directions, and copied intervals in coordinate order without selecting the resulting pattern.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Locate the missing upstream 3′ end after terminal primer removal.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Describe strand directions, terminal primer position, and remaining gap in sequence order without stating why it cannot be filled.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Predict how extending the template end permits additional complementary synthesis.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List the chromosome-end sequence before extension, the added template-end repeats, and the later fill-in interval without naming the consequence.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Trace detection, defective-material removal, template-guided replacement, and backbone sealing.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: List the intact and altered bases on both strands and every repair action in time order without naming the correct final sequence.

representation_plans.learner_operation: Predict repair consequences from when the defect is detected and whether an intact complementary template remains.
representation_plans.text_nonvisual_equivalent: Describe the defect timing, strand states, and available complementary information without selecting the repair outcome.
